question:
Given below are some idioms/phrases followed by four alternative meanings to each. Choose the response (a), (b), (c) or (d) which is the most appropriate expression and mark your response in the Answer Sheet accordingly.

Loaves and fishes
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2 i.e. (Material gain)'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "Loaves and fishes" is an idiom that refers to material or financial gain or profit.(भौतिक लाभ)

Therefore, the correct answer is: Material gain

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Accidentally kill someone" (बेहोशी में किसी की हत्या करना) means to cause the death of a person unknowingly or unintentionally.
 
• "To bury the dead" (मृतक का अंतिम संस्कार करना) refers to the act of burying a deceased person as part of a funeral rite.
 
• "To let bygones be bygones" (भूतकाल को भूतकाल ही में छोड़ देना) means to forget about unpleasant things that happened in the past and to move on.
